title: Out with the old, in with the new?
section_path: Out with the old, in with the new?
section_path_text: Out with the old, in with the new?
summary: Should owners replace older tonnage with new vessels? A few days ago, we talked to an investor who faces a dilemma. He owns several 10-year-old Medium Range (MR) product tankers, which were acquired several years ago for competitive prices at the time of purchase.
